topics.label: Course Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecturer, the scope of the cancer lecture series, and the specific learning outcomes for the session.

topics.label: Cancer Etiology, Risk Factors, and Epidemiological Evidence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the fundamental nature of cancer as a genetic and evolutionary process driven by both endogenous factors and environmental exposures.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Carcinogenesis: Initiators, Promoters, and Environmental Agents
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how specific biological, chemical, and physical agents drive cancer development through direct and indirect carcinogenic mechanisms.

topics.label: Methods for Detecting and Testing Carcinogenicity
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the genomic, epidemiological, in vivo, and in vitro methodologies used to determine and validate the carcinogenicity of various agents.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Everyday Risk Assessment
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture by reflecting on everyday risk-benefit decisions regarding carcinogen exposure.
